# Lightning Pay Kit

> Open-source React payment-help UI for BOLT11 Bitcoin Lightning invoices.

Lightning Pay Kit gives users a searchable, evidence-backed directory of wallets, payment apps, exchanges, and swaps that can hand off a Lightning invoice. It does not process payments or prove settlement.

## Links

- Website and demo: https://pseudozach.github.io/lightning-pay-kit/
- Repository: https://github.com/pseudozach/lightning-pay-kit
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lightning-pay-kit
- Provider policy: https://github.com/pseudozach/lightning-pay-kit/blob/main/docs/PROVIDER_DATA.md
- Agent guide: https://github.com/pseudozach/lightning-pay-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Install

```bash
npm install lightning-pay-kit
```

```tsx
import { LightningPaymentHelp } from "lightning-pay-kit";
import "lightning-pay-kit/styles.css";

<LightningPaymentHelp invoice={bolt11} />;
```

## Integration constraints

- Pass one unmodified BOLT11 invoice.
- Treat `handed_off` as navigation intent, never proof of payment.
- Verify settlement in the host application.
- Do not invent wallet-specific URI schemes or claim installed-wallet detection.
- The bundled provider registry is static and requires no runtime service.
- Country search uses bundled ISO metadata and shows verified local matches before eligible global providers.
- FixedFloat uses a visibly disclosed default affiliate destination. Override it with an affiliate object or disable it with `affiliateOverrides={{ fixedfloat: null }}`.
